guard: docs refuses a page with --search and --refresh without a page, loads the bundle only inside run, returns matching sections, reports a page read without --refresh as bundled and matches a slug without case or .md; the ext listing reports each entry's source, and ext root refuses --json
command: pnpm --filter cotal-ai... build && pnpm exec tsx bin/smoke/docs-ext-read.smoke.ts
why: The suite drives the built binary, so each mutation rebuilds it and the restore rebuilds it back.

mutations.name: a page and --search are both taken
mutations.find: if (page !== undefined && query !== undefined) throw usage("give a page or --search, not both");
mutations.expectRed: docs spec --search x is one USAGE_INVALID envelope, exit 1
mutations.cell: docs spec --search x is one USAGE_INVALID envelope, exit 1

mutations.name: --refresh without a page is ignored
mutations.find: if (v.refresh && page === undefined) throw usage("--refresh applies to reading a page; the index and search use the bundled docs");
mutations.expectRed: docs --refresh is one USAGE_INVALID envelope, exit 1
mutations.cell: docs --refresh is one USAGE_INVALID envelope, exit 1

mutations.name: the docs bundle is imported at startup
mutations.find: import { CommandFailure, jsonFlag, plainFlag, presentationOf, writeResult, type Cell, type Report } from "@cotal-ai/workspace";
mutations.expectRed: docs imports the bundle inside run, through its narrow subpath
mutations.cell: docs imports the bundle inside run, through its narrow subpath

mutations.name: a search returns no sections
mutations.expectRed: --search returns sections that hold the query, each naming its page
mutations.cell: --search returns sections that hold the query, each naming its page

mutations.name: a page read without --refresh claims a refresh
mutations.find: if (!opts.refresh) return { version, page: found, source: "bundled", refresh: null };
mutations.replace: if (!opts.refresh) return { version, page: found, source: "bundled", refresh: "served" };
mutations.expectRed: a page is the bundled copy, with no refresh asked
mutations.cell: a page is the bundled copy, with no refresh asked

mutations.name: a page slug is matched with case and .md
mutations.expectRed: a page's slug is matched without case or .md, and the plain page says which copy it is
mutations.cell: a page's slug is matched without case or .md, and the plain page says which copy it is

mutations.name: the listing drops whether the seed installed an entry
mutations.expectRed: ext list --json holds each installed extension once, with its spec, source and what it provides
mutations.cell: ext list --json holds each installed extension once, with its spec, source and what it provides

mutations.name: the plain listing calls every entry added
mutations.expectRed: the plain listing is a table with the source of each
mutations.cell: the plain listing is a table with the source of each

mutations.name: ext root takes --json
mutations.expectRed: ext root --json is refused as text with no envelope, exit 1
mutations.cell: ext root --json is refused as text with no envelope, exit 1

mutations.name: every ext mode reports by the listing's outputs
mutations.expectRed: a mode without structured output keeps its exit: removing a missing package exits 1
mutations.cell: a mode without structured output keeps its exit: removing a missing package exits 1

mutations.name: help shows the command's outputs on every subcommand
mutations.expectRed: help names the listing's structured output and no other mode's
mutations.cell: help names the listing's structured output and no other mode's
